name: snapcn
summary: Shadcn registry of Remotion components for React video: text animations, captions, device frames and scenes.
description: Copy-paste Remotion components for product demo, launch and social videos — kinetic text, captions, logo stings, phone/laptop/terminal mockups and whole scenes. Install with the shadcn CLI; the source lands in components/snap-cn/ and is written against the plain Remotion API. 46 components are MIT; Pro adds 51 more plus templates and an MCP server.
contains: 46 free MIT + 51 Pro Remotion components (97 total)
categories: text & titles, captions, logos, screens & devices, social proof, scenes, AI chat input
installed with npx shadcn@latest add @snapcn/<name>; files land in components/snap-cn/
plain Remotion API (useCurrentFrame, interpolate, spring); no runtime package dependency
renders to MP4 via remotion render, the SSR APIs or Remotion Lambda
works in projects without Tailwind (inline theme prop)
Pro: $129/year, $249 lifetime, $499 team; includes the MCP server
ships an agent skill (npx skills add snapcndev/snapcn)
